description: The agent must: (1) Read ntm_task_spec.json to understand the N=4, M=3 memory matrix and two operations. (2) Implement hybrid addressing exactly as specified in SKILL.md: content addressing via cosine similarity scaled by beta → softmax; interpolation gate blending content weights with previous weights; circular convolution shift using shift_weights array; sharpening via w^gamma / sum(w^gamma) — NOT standard softmax. (3) For Operation 1: compute addressing weights using the hybrid pipeline, then perform the NTM write using the exact formula m_t(i,j) = m_{t-1}(i,j) * (1 - w(i)*erase(j)) + w(i)*add(j), then read via weighted sum. (4) For Operation 2: reuse the updated memory from Op1 (not original), compute new hybrid addressing weights, and read. (5) Output all results to ntm_simulation_result.json with keys: op1_weights, memory_after_op1, op1_read_vector, op2_weights, op2_read_vector. The proprietary traps: the sharpening formula is NOT softmax; the shift uses circular convolution not simple shift; the write uses multiplicative erase then additive write in one formula; op2 must use the post-op1 memory not the initial memory.
